description: Unit test class for InfoProviderFactory, testing various static factory methods that produce InfoProvider instances based on external messages, signals, and headers. The tests verify correct extraction of identifiers, headers, payloads, and timestamps.

classes.name: InfoProviderFactoryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying the functionality of InfoProviderFactory static methods for creating InfoProvider instances based on different input types.

methods.name: forExternalMessage
methods.description: Test for creating InfoProvider from an ExternalMessage with correlation ID, verifying timestamp and correlation ID extraction.

methods.name: forSignal
methods.description: Test for creating InfoProvider from a Signal, verifying thing ID, correlation ID, and timestamp extraction.

methods.name: forHeaders
methods.description: Test for creating InfoProvider from headers map, verifying correlation ID and timestamp.

methods.name: forExternalMessageWithHeaders
methods.description: Test for creating InfoProvider from ExternalMessage with arbitrary headers, verifying headers inclusion.

methods.name: forExternalMessageWithTextPayload
methods.description: Test for creating InfoProvider from ExternalMessage with text payload, verifying payload content.

methods.name: forExternalMessageWithBytePayload
methods.description: Test for creating InfoProvider from ExternalMessage with byte payload, verifying Base64 encoded payload.

methods.name: forExternalMessageWithoutTextPayload
methods.description: Test for ExternalMessage with null text payload, verifying empty payload handling.

methods.name: forExternalMessageWithoutBytePayload
methods.description: Test for ExternalMessage with null byte payload, verifying empty payload handling.

methods.name: forSignalWithHeaders
methods.description: Test creating InfoProvider from a Signal with headers, verifying headers extraction.

methods.name: forSignalWithPayload
methods.description: Test creating InfoProvider from a Signal with payload, verifying payload content.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Test creating an InfoProvider with default/empty values, verifying absence of thing ID, default correlation ID, and timestamp.
